name: native-e2e-ci
body: Native e2e CI job: a GitHub Actions matrix with one GitHub-hosted native runner per supported target: darwin/arm64 on an Apple silicon runner (e.g. `macos-14` / `macos-latest`), windows/amd64 on `windows-latest`, and windows/arm64 on `windows-11-arm` only if that runner is available to the private repo (otherwise the target is omitted, with no self-hosted fallback). Each job runs against its target's built binary. Steps: in a clean temp dir, `eypres init`, then `eypres start --no-open` in the background; parse the printed URL; poll until HTTP 200 with the two starter slides (timeout about 30s); fetch reveal.js and theme assets and confirm they are served locally from the binary; enforce offline operation by blocking or disabling outbound network for the process or asserting no outbound connections (the mechanism is chosen per OS); terminate the process (SIGTERM on macOS, taskkill/process kill on Windows) and assert a clean exit.
